item.title: RCMP Update on Tumbler Ridge High School Shooting | Feb 10, 2026
item.description: The RCMP provides an official update following a tragic shooting at the local high school in Tumbler Ridge, BC. Authorities have confirmed 10 fatalities, including the suspect, who is believed to have died by suicide at the scene. In this press conference: Official casualty count and status of the investigation. Timeline of the events on February 10. Resources for affected families and community members. item.title: Jennifer Jacob interview with Energeticcity.ca in 2023
item.description: The mother of the Tumbler Ridge shooter spoke out about healthcare shortages in northeast B.C. just over two years before she was one of the first victims of a mass shooting perpetrated by her child. Energeticcity.ca is releasing audio from an interview conducted in November 2023, when Jennifer Jacobs - then named as Jennifer Strang - spoke about her struggles to access care in Tumbler Ridge after one of her other children developed appendicitis.
